summary:
PASS 3 (2026-08-05): re-verified every non-'match' item against the current tree per the pass-3 instruction (the tree had moved: composer-pill pass 3, commit f187d8b0, landed on ProviderModelPicker.tsx/provider-model-picker.css AFTER this map's PASS 2 note was written). Two items reclassified to 'match' on re-measurement, one bug found+fixed while measuring them: (1) the provider/model picker's per-provider 'default v' config indicator — flagged in PASS 2 as a silent omission (nothing rendered at all) — was already fixed by the intervening composer-pill pass 3 commit to the same honestly-flagged (visible, disabled, red) convention as the per-model sampling gear; with that landed, every piece of the popRouter grammar the prototype has is now either real or visibly degraded, so the whole item now reads 'match' (composer-pill.json independently reached the same verdict on the identical widget: 'Model selector and its menu -> match'). Re-measuring this widget under the real ~10-provider catalogue (side-by-side.mjs model-picker) surfaced a second, previously-unknown bug: `.provider-model-picker__panes`'s `max-height:240px` had no row-track constraint, so its implicit `auto` grid row grew past 240px uncapped and the overflow painted straight over the 'thinking' row below rather than being clipped/scrolled by the children's own `overflow-y:auto` — fixed with `grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)` + `overflow:hidden`, both visually re-verified (composite) and locked (unit test regex over the CSS rule). (2) The rail footer's 'relay' cell was found to still be exactly what the pass-2 audit_correction described — a permanently disabled dead control asserting a now-false 'no wire surface yet (clio-agent#1179)' tooltip over a route that has been live since the pass-2 settings work (Client.relayStatus(), Settings > Relays). Fixed per the audit's own prescription: the cell now fetches the same relayStatus() the Relays page uses (one-shot per connection, SessionView), drives the dot honestly (idle until the probe resolves or when nothing is configured, ok when reachable, error when not — never a false-positive green, matching the 'agents' cell's own established honesty rule) and restores click-through to Settings > Relays (Settings gained an `initialSection` prop so the rail's per-cell targets, matching the prototype's own per-cell `goSettingsRelays`/`goSettingsAgents` handlers, can deep-link instead of always landing on Settings' first page). Two items re-confirmed unchanged on re-measurement, no code touched: the rail 'agents N' cell's multi-backend switcher remains a deliberate, still-accurate documented non-fix (a real live axis — multiple connected clio deployments — the prototype's single-backend demo never modelled; Settings > Agents still serves the nav-equivalent path), and the mislabeled visual-check capture-fixture data-integrity note remains out of scope (guardrailed screenshots directory). Sweep of the rest of the surface (kit ContextMenu hover/active/disabled/danger states, the approve/mode popovers, the session/workspace context menus) found no further deviations on re-measurement — all previously verified 'match' findings hold.

PASS 2 (2026-08-05): re-verified every non-'match' item against the current tree (two intervening passes — composer-pill and rail-and-topbar — had touched ProviderModelPicker.tsx and Rail.tsx since the above; neither changed the substance of what follows). All prior 'match' findings hold on re-measurement (backend literals independently re-checked live against clio-agent src/clio_agent/gact/types.py: approval_mode and mode both still exactly as recorded). One new same-class grammar gap found by sweeping the provider/model picker's geometry against the prototype's own state machine: the popRouter block defines TWO independent resize handles — the already-implemented outer panel-width drag (`pmDragW`, default 480/360-720) and a SECOND, previously-unbuilt inner handle (`pmDragCol`, default 210/clamp 150-360) that resizes the provider column against the model column. The app had only the outer handle; the provider column was a fixed, non-resizable 178px that matched neither the prototype's 210px default nor its resizability. Fixed: added the second Splitter (normal, non-inverted drag direction, unlike the right-anchored panel handle) and corrected the default width to the measured 210px. The three items still not 'match' after re-verification are unchanged in substance — re-confirmed rather than re-argued: the per-provider config sub-picker and per-model sampling editor remain correctly wire-gapped (LmPreset type independently confirmed live at apps/core/src/wire/lm_types.ts; the only mutation path is still the global daemon config), the rail 'agents' cell's multi-backend switcher remains a deliberate, still-accurate documented non-fix (Settings > Agents equivalent still resolves), and the relay cell's unbacked flag (clio-agent#1179) is unchanged.

PASS 1 grind (2026-08-04): re-measured every item against the CURRENT tree — the mode popover and a two-pane provider/model picker had already landed since this map was written, ahead of this pass. Fixed in this pass: kit ContextMenu's separator primitive (both danger-item menus now carry the prototype's hairline), the active-item check icon's color (kit-wide, was the orange accent, now teal), the workspace menu's pin label (now toggles pin/unpin workspace like the session menu, with no check-icon column), and 'remove workspace' now goes through a confirmation modal instead of firing the DELETE straight from the click. The provider/model picker gained status-colored provider rows, a wired 'provider settings' gear, and honestly-flagged (visible, disabled, red) per-model settings gears — real grammar it lacked (a per-provider multi-config sub-picker, a live sampling-parameter editor) has no backend surface and is left unbuilt rather than faked; see wire gaps. Also fixed a kit-wide popover bug found while measuring: the composer's up-placement popovers inherit `max-height:320px; overflow-y:auto` from the shared kit-popover, but the provider/model picker's own CSS was overriding it to `overflow:hidden`, silently discarding any provider past the visible fold with no way to reach it. One deliberate, documented non-fix: the rail's 'agents' footer cell opens a live multi-backend switcher instead of the prototype's plain Settings navigation — a real axis (multiple connected clio deployments) the prototype's single-backend demo never modelled; Settings > Agents still serves the nav-equivalent path.

items.element: Provider/model picker popover (composer footer model selector)
items.proto_truth: Two-column widget, ~480px wide, resizable both dimensions. Header: eyebrow 'providers' + gear icon ('Provider settings'). Left column: one row per provider (LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, Codex, Claude Code, ALCF Sophia, ALCF Metis, vLLM) each showing name + a 'default ⌄' per-provider config picker + a color-coded status label (ready / no key / signed out / offline). Right column: models of the selected provider, each with a gear icon opening a per-model sampling-parameter editor ('saved per model on this provider'), active model shown in teal name-color + teal check. Footer row: eyebrow 'thinking' + effort chips (default/off/low/medium/high). Captured live: apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/proto-router-menu.png (source: design/prototype/Clio Session.html popRouter block).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/ProviderModelPicker.tsx (two-pane Popover, real client.providers()/providerModels()/lmConfig() data); apps/web/src/composer/provider-model-picker.css. RECLASSIFIED match in PASS 3 on re-verification: the composer-pill pass 3 commit (f187d8b0, landed between this map's PASS 2 note and this pass) already fixed the one PASS-2 'STILL missing' gap — the per-provider 'default v' config indicator was a silent omission (nothing rendered); it is now visible+disabled+flagged red (`.provider-model-picker__cfg[data-unbacked='true']`), matching the per-model sampling gear's own established convention. With that landed, every piece of grammar the prototype's popRouter block has is now either wired to real data or honestly, visibly flagged — none is silently absent, which is the bar 'match' is held to elsewhere on this surface (composer-pill.json reached the identical verdict on this same widget: 'Model selector and its menu -> match'). Re-measuring under the real ~10-provider live catalogue (apps/web/screenshots/side-by-side/menus-grammar-model.png) surfaced ONE further bug this pass fixed: see the new 'panes max-height vs thinking row overlap' item below.
items.backend_surface: PATCH /v1/sessions/{id} body.model={provider_id, model_id, variant} (per-session pick, real); GET/PUT /v1/providers/lm (global daemon LM config + presets, real); no endpoint for a per-model sampling-parameter store
items.fix_hint: Two pieces of grammar remain genuinely unbacked and are correctly left as the visible-degraded marker rather than built or hidden (re-confirmed PASS 3, unchanged from PASS 2's own re-confirmation): (1) the per-provider 'default ⌄' config sub-picker — the DATA exists (GET /v1/providers/lm's presets[] can have >1 entry per provider — e.g. argonne_metis + argonne_sophia both provider:'argonne', confirmed live; LmPreset type re-confirmed at apps/core/src/wire/lm_types.ts) but the only mutation path (PUT /v1/providers/lm) changes the GLOBAL daemon LM config, not a per-session pick — wiring a per-provider switcher into a per-session composer popover would have every session's composer silently reconfigure every OTHER session's model, a real product/architecture call outside a menu-grammar polish pass. (2) The sampling-parameter editor content itself (gear -> a 'sampling · {model}' back-panel with numeric override rows) has zero wire surface at all — PATCH's `variant` field is never populated from a real store.

items.element: kit Popover model picker — `.panes` max-height had no row-track constraint, so the live ~10-provider list painted over the 'thinking' row
items.proto_truth: N/A (a kit-bug finding surfaced by the live provider catalogue outgrowing the prototype's fixed 3-item placeholder set, not a prototype-vs-source comparison — same class as the earlier 'silently killed the inherited scroll' finding below, found this pass while re-measuring the reclassified item above).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/provider-model-picker.css:.provider-model-picker__panes — `max-height:240px` alone does nothing to an implicit `auto` CSS Grid row: with no row-track constraint the row grows to its content's max-content size regardless of the container's max-height, and the overflow paints straight through onto the 'thinking' row that follows in normal flow (caught live via side-by-side.mjs model-picker against the real ~10-provider backend: ALCF Sophia's row visibly overlapped the THINKING eyebrow+chips). Fixed with `grid-template-rows:minmax(0,1fr)` + `overflow:hidden`, which lets the row actually shrink to the max-height and hands scrolling to the children's own already-correct `overflow-y:auto`. Verified visually (re-captured apps/web/screenshots/side-by-side/menus-grammar-model.png: clean hairline between the clipped provider list and 'thinking', no overlap) and locked in apps/web/tests/unit/menus-grammar-p5.test.tsx ('the panes area actually clips at its max-height' describe block, regex over the CSS rule).

items.fix_hint: DELIBERATE, documented non-fix (same class of call as the approval-mode content divergence): the prototype's static single-backend demo never modelled switching between MULTIPLE live clio deployments, which is a real feature this app has (App's ConnectionPool, real tests at tests/unit/shell.test.tsx:270-325). Rewriting the click to only navigate would delete a working, tested feature with no replacement UI. Settings > Agents (AgentsPage) already lists the same `connections` for a user who wants the prototype's nav path instead — so the ground truth's DESTINATION is reachable, just not as this cell's only affordance. Re-verified PASS 3: still holds, unchanged. (Note: PASS 3 gave `onOpenSettings` an optional `section` argument so the sibling 'relay' cell could deep-link to Settings > Relays — the 'agents' cell deliberately does not use it, since its whole point is the switcher, not navigation.)

items.proto_truth: `<button title="Relays — opens settings" onclick={goSettingsRelays}>` with a live green status dot — navigates into Settings > Relays. design/prototype/Clio Session.html rail footer block.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx (footer 'relay' button, `data-testid="rail-relay"`) now fetches this backend's own GET /v1/relay/status once per connection (apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx, mirrors RelaysPage's own one-shot fetch) and threads it down through AppShell as a `relayStatus` prop. The dot is honest, not a copy of the prototype's static green: 'idle' before the probe resolves or when nothing is configured, 'ok' when reachable, 'error' when not (never a false-positive green, the same rule already applied to the 'agents' dot). Click-through restored: `onClick={() => onOpenSettings?.('relays')}` — Settings.tsx gained an `initialSection` prop (falls back to the first backed page when the id is not currently backed) so the click lands on Settings > Relays directly rather than whatever page Settings opened to last, matching the prototype's own per-cell `goSettingsRelays` handler. Locked in apps/web/tests/unit/menus-grammar-p5.test.tsx (two describe blocks: the Rail-level dot/title/click-through matrix, and a SessionView integration test asserting the Settings layer opens with 'relays' pre-selected — `aria-current="page"` — and renders RelaysPage's real content, not a placeholder). Verified visually: apps/web/screenshots/side-by-side/menus-grammar-relay.png (rail footer, both dots green against the real reachable backend) — pixel-cropped confirmation that the app's relay dot color matches the prototype's.

items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/popover.css:.kit-popover[data-placement='up'] sets `max-height:320px; overflow-y:auto`; apps/web/src/composer/provider-model-picker.css was overriding it with `overflow:hidden`, so any provider past the visible fold (the live backend surfaces up to 10) was simply unreachable — not scrollable, not visible, no error.
